operations.name: chat.threads.read
operations.summary: Read the thread thread of the conversation address: {address, thread, messages, complete}, messages oldest first, each {ts, thread, text, author}, author {account, kind} with kind person or automation; complete says whether every message was answered.

operations.name: chat.threads.post
operations.summary: Post text into the conversation address, into the thread thread when one is named: answered {address, ts, thread, text, author, replayed}. The product's tool recognises a repeated request_id itself and posts nothing.
